seo_title: Pawsword: iOS and Mac App Design | The Brandle
summary: An offline password manager for iPhone and Mac with a bear for a mascot: no account, no cloud, no subscription.

brief.label: iOS and Mac app
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Pawsword is a password manager that works offline. Every password lives in one encrypted file on your own device. No account, no cloud, no subscription. You pay once.
The mascot is Pocket, a bear. Bears keep their family safe in a den with no signal, which is more than most apps can say.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: The build
paras: We named it (four rounds, the pun won), drew the bear, designed the app and built it for iPhone and Mac. It went live on the App Store in November 2026.

The app has no network permission at all. It could not phone home if it wanted to. The first rule of the build was that the vault cannot be lost, so there are backups, a recovery screen and a paper copy you print at setup.
We also made the site, where a sleeping bear does most of the selling.
